title: Professional Certificate Course in Strategic Problem-Solving Framework and Technology in Decision-Making
description: Embark on a transformative journey where strategic problem-solving meets cutting-edge technology, shaping the future of decision-making excellence.
longDescription: Define strategic problem-solving and its significance in managerial decision-making. Discuss established frameworks (McKinsey’s 8-step process) for structured problem-solving. Explore technology's role in augmenting decision-making processes, emphasizing data analytics, AI, and decision support systems. Highlight how technology enhances problem-solving stages like data processing, collaboration, decision analysis, and implementation. Include real-life examples demonstrating the successful application of problem-solving frameworks coupled with technology in managerial decision-making scenarios. Discuss challenges faced when implementing these frameworks and technologies, including issues with data accuracy, bias, and adaptability. This course delves into the realm of strategic problem-solving, exploring its pivotal role in managerial decision-making. Participants will dissect established frameworks such as McKinsey's 8-step process, while also delving into the transformative impact of technology on decision-making processes.
